exposure: Induction of labor using outpatient mechanical cervical ripening using a Foley catheter (OFC)
Induction of labor using inpatient chemical ripening using prostin gel (IPG)
outcome: Incremental cost per predelivery inpatient hour prevented
Incremental cost per vaginal delivery within 12 h of admission to the birthing unit
cohort: Women in a metropolitan Australian maternity hospital with an unfavorable cervix requiring IOL at term.
finding: While OFC was associated with fewer predelivery inpatient hours and costs, it did not reduce overall inpatient hours and did not achieve comparable rates of vaginal delivery within 12 hours of birthing unit admission compared to IPG.
